candidates.name: README ordering
candidates.reason: The September 30 PR moves the NIP-A3 README entry into list order. It supplies no new wire format, deployed behavior or substantive Nostr capability. Score 1/10: direct proposed documentation edit, no material protocol delta.

candidates.name: Preferred relay list proposal
candidates.reason: The proposal was opened July 23, 2025. Current-window activity merges master into the existing proposal; no newly verified proposal or implementation milestone is established. Score 2/10: readable source proposal but no material in-window novelty.

candidates.name: Hidden replies set proposal
candidates.reason: New September 29 NIP-51 proposal introduces a hidden replies set using kind 30027. Discussion leaves format details unresolved. The author claims a Nostrich implementation; review of 594 public source files did not verify kind 30027 support in that inspected source. This does not establish that no implementation exists. Score 8/10: reviewable new Nostr proposal milestone (significance2, impact1, novelty2, maturity1, explanatory2). The actual specification draft supplies primary evidence independently of its unverified implementation claim.

score_axis_reasons.nostr_significance: 2: Defines a root-author-signed relay event and concrete client interpretation for public thread moderation.
score_axis_reasons.user_operator_impact: 1: Potentially useful author control, but current impact is prospective; released client behavior was not verified.
score_axis_reasons.novelty: 2: New September29 proposal, revised in-window from a per-user list to a per-thread addressable set.
score_axis_reasons.evidence_maturity: 1: Complete primary diff and live discussion support the proposal; it remains open and the author's implementation claim was not established from the public repository.
score_axis_reasons.explanatory_value: 2: Clearly distinguishes client display requests from relay publication control and explains how per-thread sets narrow edit contention.
